citation: herdr v0.8.0 src/detect/mod.rs (identification tests) and src/pane.rs (probe order and hint tests); each case names the test it came from. Windows-only cases (cmd, PowerShell) are not ported: Muster runs daemons on macOS and Linux.
why: Most agents are not the process the kernel names - they are node or python running a script, a Nix wrapper, a thread-named binary, or a shell script - so which agent a pane runs is a search, and each of these cases is a way it has gone wrong before. `given` is the foreground group as the kernel reports it: each process's pid, comm name, argv and, where macOS reports it, argv[0]; `hints` are MUSTER_AGENT values by pid; `shell` is the pane's own pid. `expect` is the agent's id, the name it was recognised by, and whether the pane's shell is in the foreground; an empty expect is no agent.

cases.name: a runtime is unwrapped to the script it runs
cases.why: Most agents are a node script, so the kernel calls the process node; the script's name is the agent's. The script's name is what it is known by. (identify_agent_in_job_prefers_wrapped_codex)

cases.name: a recognised group leader wins over a member
cases.why: The leader is the job the shell started; a member that looks like an agent is usually a tool the agent itself launched, such as an MCP server. (identify_agent_in_job_prefers_recognized_process_group_leader)

cases.name: an unrecognised leader falls back to the members
cases.why: A shell wrapper leading the group does not hide the agent it runs. (identify_agent_in_job_falls_back_when_process_group_leader_is_unrecognized)

cases.name: a Nix wrapper is known by its argv[0]
cases.why: Nix installs agents as .<name>-wrapped executables called by their real name, so argv[0] is the name that means something. (identify_agent_in_job_detects_nix_wrapped_codex_from_cmdline_argv0)

cases.name: a Nix-wrapped alias resolves to the agent's id
cases.why: An alias found by unwrapping reports the agent's own id, not the alias. (identify_agent_in_job_canonicalizes_nix_wrapped_aliases_from_cmdline_argv0)

cases.name: a shell running a script is the script
cases.why: An agent installed as a shell script runs as sh with the script as its argument. (identify_agent_in_job_detects_shell_wrapped_pi)

cases.name: node running pi's package entry point is pi
cases.why: pi's package runs as node with a path inside node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent; pi's manifest names that path in script_paths. herdr's case used a Windows path; this one is the Unix equivalent. (identify_agent_in_job_detects_node_wrapped_pi_package_cli)

cases.name: another script in pi's package is not pi
cases.why: Only the package's CLI is the agent; a build script inside the same package is not. (identify_agent_in_job_ignores_non_cli_pi_package_script)

cases.name: opencode2 is opencode
cases.why: An older name opencode was installed under. (identify_agent_in_job_detects_opencode2_as_opencode)

cases.name: opencode.exe from a pnpm package is opencode
cases.why: opencode's npm package ships its binary as opencode.exe on every platform, and the name is reported as the kernel gave it. (identify_agent_in_job_detects_opencode_exe_from_pnpm_package)

cases.name: a thread-named process is known by its argv[0] path
cases.why: Bun-compiled binaries report their main thread's name to the kernel, so the path in argv[0] is the only name there is. (identify_agent_in_job_detects_opencode_exe_from_argv0_path)

cases.name: python -c code is not an agent
cases.why: Code passed on the command line is not a script, whatever arguments follow it. (identify_agent_in_job_ignores_python_c_argument_named_codex)

cases.name: node -e code is not an agent
cases.why: The same for node's eval flag. (identify_agent_in_job_ignores_node_eval_argument_named_codex)

cases.name: bash -c code is not an agent
cases.why: And for a shell's. (identify_agent_in_job_ignores_shell_c_argument_named_codex)

cases.name: a python script named for an agent is that agent
cases.why: A script path is a name, and python running it is the runtime being unwrapped. (identify_agent_in_job_detects_python_script_named_codex)

cases.name: an argv[0] reported apart from comm is preferred
cases.why: macOS reports argv[0] separately, and a runtime that renamed itself shows there: node running pi with process.title set is pi. (herdr's process_argv0_name, src/platform/macos.rs)

cases.name: a retitled argv[0] with spaces is split
cases.why: A runtime that set its title to a whole command line has one argv[0] with spaces in it; the first word is the name. (cmdline_argv0_agent_name, src/detect/mod.rs)

cases.name: sleep is not an agent
cases.why: The ordinary case: most foreground jobs are not agents, and must stay unknown. (foreground_job_detects_sleep)

cases.name: a hint on the leader wins over its name
cases.why: MUSTER_AGENT is how a person or a wrapper says what a process is when its name does not; a hint on the leader beats the leader's own name. The name reported is the agent's id. (src/pane.rs, foreground_agent_hint_wins_over_process_name_detection)

cases.name: a hint on the pane's shell counts
cases.why: A pane started with MUSTER_AGENT in its shell's environment is that agent while the shell leads the foreground. (src/pane.rs, foreground_agent_hint_accepts_pane_shell_environment)

cases.name: a hint on an unrecognised leader is authoritative
cases.why: A leader nobody could name is whatever its hint says. (src/pane.rs, foreground_agent_hint_on_inherited_child_environment_is_authoritative)

cases.name: a member's hint does not override an identifiable leader
cases.why: The leader is the job; a member's environment is inherited clutter unless nothing better is known. (src/pane.rs, non_leader_agent_hint_does_not_override_identifiable_leader)

cases.name: a member's hint wins when the leader is unidentified
cases.why: With no name for the leader, a member's hint is the best evidence there is. (src/pane.rs, non_leader_agent_hint_wins_when_leader_is_unidentified)

cases.name: a member's hint counts in a job led by a wrapper
cases.why: A sandbox wrapper can lead the group while the agent runs under it with its hint. (src/pane.rs, foreground_agent_hint_accepts_non_leader_foreground_process_environment)

cases.name: a hint naming no agent is no hint
cases.why: An unknown name in MUSTER_AGENT identifies nothing, and does not stop the process's own name from counting. (src/platform/mod.rs, parse_agent_env_hint)

cases.name: the shell in the foreground is noticed
cases.why: Whether the pane's own shell is back in the foreground is what tells the loop an agent has exited. (src/pane.rs, process_probe_result)
